title: Flockdeck structured pane push
description: The message a window gets from structuredSnapshot, and as a push after structuredWatch, for one structured pane. The document root is that message. It carries the pane's state and no conversation, which is read with the conversation commands. An object with a field not named here is not one Flockdeck writes. A field is either always present or absent for the reason its description gives; no field is null. Every text is untrusted: it is what the agent said, cleaned of control characters and cut on a character boundary, and a window shows it as plain text.

req.description: The token the window sent with the command, copied to the answer to structuredSnapshot and to the first message after structuredWatch. Absent on a later push.

kind.description: How the pane is run. Always written.

gone.description: Present, and true, on the last message of a watch whose pane has closed. The other fields are then empty. Absent otherwise.

phase.description: Where the agent is in its life. Absent when gone.

status.description: What a ready agent is doing: working on a turn, waiting on a permission request, or idle. Absent unless the phase is ready.

activity.description: The line naming what a working agent is doing, as one line. Absent when there is none.

queued.description: How many prompts wait behind the running turn. Absent when none do.

queue.description: The prompts waiting behind the running turn, the next to be sent first (since API 1.19). Same length as queued; absent when none wait.

shell.description: The person's own commands, run with ! in the prompt box, the oldest first (since API 1.20). Not the agent's: they never reach it unless the person sends one's output. Absent when there are none.

rewindPoints.description: The ids of the prompt entries the conversation can be taken back to, oldest first, the newest 200 at most (since API 1.25). A prompt is listed when the turn before it ended by itself. Absent when the agent cannot go back or no prompt qualifies. Name the prompt by this id in structuredRewind and structuredFork.

rewindToken.description: Names the list in rewindPoints, and changes when the pane's conversation is gone back in or the pane restarts. Send it back in structuredRewind and structuredFork; a request with another token is refused as stale (since API 1.25). Present with rewindPoints.

err.description: The last thing that went wrong, on one line, without control characters, cut to 200 characters. It says what last went wrong and not that something is wrong now: show it with the phase and status. Absent when nothing has.

plan.description: The agent's plan, at most 100 rows. Empty, never absent.

title.description: The session's title, as the agent set it (session_info_update), on one line, cut to 300 bytes. Absent when it has none. Since API 1.12.

commands.description: The slash commands the agent offers (available_commands_update), at most 200. The agent's latest list replaces the one before. Absent when it has offered none. Since API 1.12.

modes.description: The modes of the session and the current one: the modes block of session/new (Gemini), with current_mode_update applied. Absent when the agent has no such block and has named no mode; agents that keep the mode as a config option list it in configOptions. Since API 1.12.

models.description: The models of the session and the current one: the models block of session/new. Absent when the agent sent none; agents that keep the model as a config option list it in configOptions. Since API 1.12.

configOptions.description: The settings the agent exposes (opencode, Codex: model, effort, mode), at most 32, as of its last config_option_update. Absent when it exposes none. Since API 1.12.

planMarkdown.description: The plan an agent sent as markdown (plan_update), cut to 64 KiB. Draw it as sanitised markdown, never as HTML. Absent when none was sent. It is separate from plan, which holds rows. Since API 1.12.

shellItem.description: One command the person ran with !, in the pane's directory, in a shell Flockdeck owns with a scrubbed environment. It is ended when the pane closes or after ten minutes. Name it in structuredShell* commands by id.

id.description: Stays with the run until it is removed.

cmd.description: The command as one line, cut to 500 characters, with control and format characters removed. Draw it as text.

state.description: running; exited (it ended by itself, see code); stopped (the person stopped it, or the pane closed); timeout (ended for running longer than ten minutes); failed (it could not be started).

code.description: The exit code. Present when state is exited.

text.description: The output so far as plain text, cut to its newest 8192 bytes: escape sequences, carriage-return overwrites, control characters (other than line break and tab) and format characters are removed. Draw it as text and never as markup.

cut.description: Present when the start of the output was let go, either by the cut above or because the run wrote more than 64 KiB.

queueItem.description: One prompt waiting for its turn. Name it in structuredQueue* commands by id, never by pos: the list shortens as turns end, and a command about a prompt that has been sent is refused.

id.description: Stays with the prompt until it is sent or removed; not reused by a pane's next session.

pos.description: Place in the queue, 1 is next.

kind.description: user is text the person typed. mail is a message from another agent. flockdeck is a prompt Flockdeck sent itself (the pane's opening prompt). Mail and flockdeck prompts cannot be edited or removed, and clear leaves them.

peer.description: For mail: the sender's label, one line, with format and direction characters removed. Show it beside the text and never inside it.

text.description: The prompt, or for mail the message body, cut to 2000 bytes. Plain text; draw it as text and never as markup. For kind user it is the person's text as typed (tabs, indentation and joiners kept, control characters other than line break and tab removed), so an edit can start from it; mail has its format and direction characters (Unicode Cf) removed.

clipped.description: Present when text was cut. Such a prompt cannot be edited; the desk refuses an edit of one.

filesMessage.description: The answer to structuredFiles (since API 1.18), not the document root: file names for the prompt box's @ picker. Names are slash-separated paths relative to the pane's directory, best match first, at most 50, each valid UTF-8 without control characters and at most 300 bytes. Only names are read, never contents.

req.description: The window's token, copied from the command.

q.description: The query as it was matched: cut to 200 bytes, without control characters.

more.description: Present when the list was cut by the limit on names or by the limit on entries read.

error.description: Fixed text, when the directory could not be read or the window asked too often. Then files is empty.

command.description: One slash command. Run it by sending a prompt that starts with a slash and the name; the agent takes it from there.

name.description: The command's name without the slash, on one line, cut to 300 bytes.

description.description: What it does, on one line, cut to 400 bytes. Absent when the agent gave none.

hint.description: The placeholder for its argument, when it takes one, cut to 300 bytes.

choice.description: One mode or model on offer.

id.description: The agent's id for it, cut to 300 bytes.

choices.description: The modes or the models of a session. At most 500 choices.

current.description: The id of the current one. Absent when the agent named none.

available.description: What is on offer. Empty, never absent.

configValue.description: One value a select option can be set to.

group.description: The name of the group the agent listed it under, when it grouped its values.

id.description: The agent's id for it, cut to 300 bytes.

category.description: The agent's grouping for it: mode, model, thought_level, or one it made up. Cut to 40 bytes.

type.description: select in the current ACP schema. Only a select option has values.

current.description: The value it is set to, as text (a boolean reads true or false). Cut to 300 bytes.

values.description: What it can be set to, at most 500. Empty, never absent.

capabilities.description: What the agent said it can do at initialize. Present while the phase is ready. A capability the agent did not claim is false. Since API 1.12.

loadSession.description: It can load an earlier session (session/load).

embeddedContext.description: A prompt may embed a file's content as a resource.

mcpHttp.description: It takes MCP servers over HTTP.

mcpSse.description: It takes MCP servers over SSE.

resumeSession.description: It can resume a session without replaying it.

rewind.description: It is one of Flockdeck's own adapters and can go back to an earlier prompt and fork at one (structuredRewind, structuredFork). Since API 1.25.

setup.description: Present while the phase is needs setup: what the person has to do before the agent can start. Absent otherwise.

kind.description: login, the only kind. Before API 1.16 it could also be node or install; an agent that cannot be found or started is now the failed phase with the fixed err text, not a setup. Always written.

message.description: What the agent said, on one line, cut to 300 bytes. Absent when it said nothing.

fix.description: What to do about it (the catalog's advice for a login), on one line, cut to 300 bytes. Absent when there is none.

signIn.description: Present while the pane waits for a login that Flockdeck can run through the agent's adapter, and while a sign-in started from the pane has a state. Absent otherwise. Since API 1.24 (cap structuredSignIn). Start it with structuredSignIn, end it with structuredSignInCancel; the pane restarts by itself when the sign-in ends well.

available.description: The pane waits for a login and its adapter can run one. False when only the state of an earlier sign-in is shown.

state.description: Absent before a sign-in is started. starting (the login command has not printed its address yet); waiting (url is the page to open and the command waits for the person); done (the command ended well, the pane restarts); failed (it failed, timed out or could not start; say so in fixed words and offer to try again). Never carries text from the agent.

url.description: The page to sign in on. Present in the state waiting. https only, no user name or password, no port, ASCII only, at most 2048 bytes, and on a host from the adapter's own exact list (Flockdeck's own adapters only). It is the only string in the block that came from the agent's login command. Draw it as a link that opens outside the app (rel noopener noreferrer), and show its host.

planRow.description: One row of the agent's plan.

content.description: The row, on one line, cut to 200 bytes.

option.description: One choice on a permission card, as the agent named it. An answer to permissionAnswer uses its id.

id.description: The agent's option id, cut to 100 bytes.

name.description: The button's text, cut to 100 bytes.

kind.description: allow_once, allow_always, reject_once, reject_always, or another the agent used.

card.description: The permission request that is open. Present while the status is waiting. It is answered with permissionAnswer from a window on this machine, and with nothing else.

seq.description: Made by Flockdeck, one more for each card. Sent back in permissionAnswer's cardSeq.

requestId.description: The agent's request id, cut to 300 bytes.

tool.description: The tool the request is for, on one line, cut to 300 bytes.

summary.description: What the agent said it would do, on one line, cut to 300 bytes.

file.description: The file it concerns, cut to 300 bytes.

command.description: The command it would run, on one line, cut to 500 bytes. It is clipped and not scrubbed of secrets, which is why this push is for a window on this machine only.

body.description: The text the request shows about its call, such as the plan of a request to leave plan mode, cut to 32 KiB. Plain text from the agent: draw it as text, never as markup or HTML, and never as part of Flockdeck's own interface. Absent when the request has none. Since API 1.22.

diff.description: The unified diff of the edit the request asks about, cut to 64 KiB. Plain text; draw it as text. Absent when the request is not for an edit. Since API 1.22.

questions.description: The questions of a card the agent asks the person (kind question), at most 4. Answer the card with permissionAnswer: the option whose kind starts with allow and an answers list, or a refusing option and none. Absent for any other card. Since API 1.22.

clipped.description: A field was cut. Absent when none was.

question.description: One question of a question card. All of its text comes from the agent and is drawn as plain text. The person answers it with option positions and, as the card always allows, text of their own. Name it in permissionAnswer's answers by its position in the list.

header.description: A short label, on one line, cut to 300 bytes.

multiSelect.description: More than one option may be chosen. Absent when only one may.

options.description: The choices, at most 8, in the agent's order; an answer names one by its position. Empty when the question takes only typed text.

label.description: On one line, cut to 300 bytes.

usage.description: What the agent reports of its context, and of its cost when it reports one. Zero while it has reported nothing.

cost.description: The cost the agent reported, in currency. Absent when it reported none; a free tier reports 0, which is absent as well.

currency.description: The currency of cost. Absent with it.
